# ms-go-statistic

Telemetry collector that stores fine-grained coding task events into ClickHouse. Follows the same Echo/zerolog/caarlos configuration style as other Go services in this monorepo.

## Features
- HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/stat` for session start and batched events.
- Optional WebSocket endpoint `/ws/v1/stat/events` that reuses the same pipeline.
- Buffered in-memory sink with size/timeout based flushing into ClickHouse.
- Internal health endpoint at `/internal/health`.

## Configuration
Environment variables (see `.env.example`):

- `STAT_HTTP_HOST` / `STAT_HTTP_PORT` / `STAT_HTTP_BASE_PATH`
- `STAT_CLICKHOUSE_DSN` (e.g. `tcp://localhost:9001?database=default` for local Docker)
- `STAT_BATCH_SIZE`, `STAT_BATCH_FLUSH_MS`, `STAT_BUFFER_SIZE`, `STAT_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT`
- optional `STAT_NATS_URL` / `STAT_NATS_PUBLISH_TIMEOUT` for interesting-activity events
- `STAT_INTERNAL_TOKEN` for the private session-summary projection

For the D8 native development loop, see [docs/native-development.md](docs/native-development.md).

## Running locally
```bash
task up        # start standalone ClickHouse + JetStream + service with docker-compose
task migrate-up # apply migrations to standalone ClickHouse
task run       # run service using local Go toolchain
task test      # run unit tests
```

## HTTP API
- `POST /api/v1/stat/session/start`
  - Headers: `X-User-Id` (UUID), `X-User-Role` (string), optional `X-Language`.
  - Body fields: `course_id`, `lesson_id`, `task_id`, `platform`, `editor_mode`, optional `client_ts`, `payload`.
  - Response: `{ "session_id": "...", "started_at": "RFC3339 timestamp" }`
- `POST /api/v1/stat/events`
  - Headers: same as above.
  - Body root fields applied to events unless overridden: `course_id`, `lesson_id`, `task_id`, `platform`, `editor_mode`.
  - `events` array items: `session_id`, `event_type`, optional `platform`, `editor_mode`, `client_ts`, `payload` (arbitrary JSON object), optional overrides for course/task identifiers.
  - Response: HTTP 202 `{ "accepted": N }`
- `GET /internal/health` → `{ "status": "ok" }`
- `GET /api/v1/stat/summary/task/:task_id` → one user-scoped task summary.
- `GET /api/v1/stat/summary/tasks` → filtered, paginated user-scoped task summaries.
- `GET /api/v1/stat/summary/session/:session_id` → user-scoped active-learning summary.
- `GET /internal/v1/students/:student_id/learning-sessions/:session_id/summary` → exact-token service projection.

Ingestion acknowledgements mean accepted by the process-local buffer, not yet
durably stored in ClickHouse. See the [documentation index](docs/README.md) for
the exact current delivery, security, schema, and summary contracts.

## WebSocket
- Endpoint: `GET /ws/v1/stat/events`
- Headers: `X-User-Id`, `X-User-Role`, optional `X-Language`.
- Messages:
  - `{"type":"session_start", ...fields of POST /session/start...}`
  - `{"type":"events_batch", ...fields of POST /events...}`
- Responses: `session_started` ACK with session id, or `events_accepted` summary; errors are returned as `{"error":"..."}`.

## Data model
ClickHouse table `stat_events` (see `migrations/0001_init.up.sql`) with a single denormalized row per event, ordered by `task_id`, `user_id`, `session_id`, `event_ts`.
